title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions from this week's verified Israel Sports Pulse coverage, spanning basketball history, gymnastics gold in Zagreb, and transfer-market intrigue.

questions.question: What score secured Artem Dolgopyat's third European floor exercise gold in Zagreb on 21 August 2026?
questions.explanation: Dolgopyat scored 14.466 in the final to beat silver medallist Arsenii Dukhno (14.333) and bronze medallist Harry Hepworth (14.300).

questions.question: Maccabi Tel Aviv beat which club 81–67 in the 2001 FIBA SuproLeague final in Paris?
questions.explanation: Maccabi beat Panathinaikos 81–67 at the Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy on 13 May 2001, having beaten CSKA Moscow in the semifinal.

questions.question: Which club did EuroCup Finals MVP Johnathan Motley join after leaving Hapoel Tel Aviv this summer?
questions.explanation: Motley left Hapoel Tel Aviv, despite having already signed a contract extension, to join Crvena Zvezda, reuniting with former teammate Chris Jones.

questions.question: Which Israeli midfielder already plays for Ferencváros, the club reportedly chasing Maccabi Netanya's Bassam Zaarura?
questions.explanation: Ferencváros already field Israeli midfielder Gabi Kanichowsky, a former Maccabi Tel Aviv player, according to ONE's report on the Zaarura interest.

questions.question: Who scored the 75th-minute penalty that sealed Maccabi Tel Aviv's 3-1 youth league win at Maccabi Petah Tikva?
questions.explanation: Roy Gafni converted a 75th-minute penalty to complete the 3-1 scoreline in round two of the Youth Premier League.
